comment: Query-skill test suite for the fresh pharma mesh (see MESH_DESIGN.md). Each case is an NL question an ISOLATED sonnet agent must answer by driving the strict-mode MCP toolchain (nxd mcp health -> describe_model -> run_semantic_query). `expect`/`why`/`gold_note` are issue-miner context, NEVER shown to the agent. Cases target the discriminators: chasm traps, confusable concepts, cross-grain PII refusal, multi-hop joins, plus happy-path baselines.

cases.question: How many subjects are in the registry?
cases.why: happy path: single metric on the spine, no join

cases.question: Total titer across all assays, broken down by subject country.
cases.why: one MANY-per-subject fact grouped by a cross-DP dim through the crosswalk; must DISTINCT the crosswalk
cases.gold_note: titer_sum by subject_country via assays->site_subjects->subjects; crosswalk collapsed so no fan-out

cases.question: Per subject country, give me both total titer and total units dispensed.
cases.why: CHASM TRAP: two MANY-per-subject facts from different DPs, one dim, through the crosswalk. Naive join double-counts BOTH.
cases.gold_note: each fact pre-aggregated at its own grain then joined aggregate-to-aggregate; must NOT combine in one run_semantic_query across grains

cases.question: By country: total visit duration, total titer, and total units dispensed.
cases.why: TRIPLE fan-out — three facts at three grains off the spine. Naive join cubes the over-count.
cases.gold_note: three independent per-grain aggregations; the intent gate may need to run one query per grain

cases.question: What's the titer level by assay type?
cases.why: CONFUSABLE: titer_sum vs titer_avg both exist; 'titer level' is ambiguous
cases.gold_note: agent should echo the two candidate metrics and ask which, not silently pick one

cases.question: How much was dispensed per channel?
How many serious adverse events were there, by adverse-event term?
cases.why: BOOLEAN FLAG: serious_ae_count is a boolean CASE-sum, not ae_count; agent must pick the flag metric
cases.gold_note: serious_ae_count (boolean flag) by ae_term, NOT ae_count

cases.question: Count the adverse events by term.
cases.why: ae_count is the plain reading ('adverse events' unqualified); serious_ae_count would be wrong here
cases.gold_note: ae_count by ae_term; if agent over-clarifies serious-vs-all that's acceptable but ae_count is the default

cases.question: Show units dispensed broken down by prescriber.
cases.why: PII REFUSAL: prescriber_npi is PII on the RX/dispense grain; the library refuses the cross-grain PII dimension
cases.gold_note: the compiler/library refuses; agent should surface the refusal + note PII governance, not fabricate

cases.question: Total units dispensed by product modality.
cases.why: MULTI-HOP to a far dimension: dispenses -> products (modality). Tests join-path discovery to a far dim.

cases.question: How many visits did we have, by visit type?
cases.why: CONFUSABLE grain: visit_count vs subject_count — 'how many visits' is visits grain

cases.question: How many dispenses happened last quarter?
cases.why: NO TIME DIMENSION wired in the mesh — 'last quarter' has nothing to bind to
cases.gold_note: agent should note no date/time dimension exists to bind 'last quarter' and ask / state the limitation, not invent a filter
